suggestions.signal_name: ECI Wages & Salaries vs Benefits split (ECIWAG / ECIBEN)
suggestions.observation: Total compensation blends wages and benefits; the wage component is the cleaner wage-price-spiral read and the benefits component is contract-lagged.
suggestions.rationale: The wages-only series may carry the Fed-relevant signal with less smoothing.

suggestions.observation: MONTHLY wage-growth measure (median, matched-person) — 3x the observation density of ECI with a similar economic object.
suggestions.rationale: If quarterly granularity is the binding constraint here, the monthly tracker offers the same hypothesis with ~300 obs.

suggestions.signal_name: ECI YoY minus CPI YoY (real wage growth)
suggestions.observation: Real (inflation-adjusted) compensation growth separates wage-price-spiral pressure from pure price inflation.
suggestions.rationale: The Fed reaction function arguably keys on real wage growth vs productivity.
suggestions.caveats: Two-series composite — out of current single-indicator scope.
